category_edits.rationale: Scale each existing input embedding by 1.1 when the nonpadding item appeared earlier in its supplied causal sequence prefix. This repeat indicator uses no targets or external data and preserves embedding parameters, GRU topology, readout, loss, and optimizer. The generated predictor imports the updated model class, ensuring identical inference features across all four categories.

edits.find:
def encode(self, seq: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        emb = self.dropout(self.item_emb(seq))

def forward(self, seq: torch.Tensor, pos: torch.Tensor, neg: torch.Tensor):
        emb = self.dropout(self.item_emb(seq))
edits.replace:
def forward(self, seq: torch.Tensor, pos: torch.Tensor, neg: torch.Tensor):
        emb = self.input_embeddings(seq)

change_summary: Add causal repeat-item input scaling consistently during training and prediction for all four category models. Preserve the existing 200-epoch default and single-model routing.
